user.title: Connect Discord bot
user.description: Create a bot in the Discord Developer Portal, enable Server Members Intent and Presence Intent and invite it to your server (bot scope; no administrator permission needed). Paste the bot token here. See the repository documentation for all steps.

guild.title: Choose Discord server
guild.description: Choose a server the bot has joined. Member access will be checked automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Discord bot token
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token is no longer valid. Enter a valid bot token with access to the same server.

error.invalid_auth: The bot token is invalid. Use a bot token, not a user token or client secret.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Discord. Check your Internet connection and try again.
error.missing_permissions: Discord denied access. Enable Server Members Intent and Presence Intent in the bot settings and ensure the bot is a member of this server.
error.server_not_found: The server is no longer accessible to this bot.
error.rate_limited: Discord is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.no_servers: The bot has not joined any servers. Invite it to your server, then submit the token again.

abort.already_configured: This Discord server is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The bot token was updated successfully.

init.title: Member synchronization
init.description: Interval for all members of this server. Changes trigger an immediate synchronization. Default: 30 minutes.

error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1440 minutes.

invalid_message.message: The message must contain 1 to 2000 characters and cannot be blank.

invalid_recipient.message: Select an existing Discord member device, not a central configuration device.

entry_not_ready.message: The selected Discord integration entry is not loaded.

dm_invalid_auth.message: The bot token is invalid. Authenticate the integration again.

dm_forbidden.message: Discord denied the direct message. The member may block DMs or the bot.

dm_rate_limited.message: Discord is rate limiting requests. No automatic resend will occur.

dm_failed.message: The Discord request failed. Delivery may be uncertain; no automatic resend will occur.

voice_channel_missing.message: This voice channel is no longer available.

voice_not_ready.message: Connect the bot to a voice channel while the Discord connection is available.

voice_permissions.message: The bot needs View Channel, Connect and Speak permissions for this channel.

voice_connection_failed.message: Joining or switching the voice channel failed. Check voice networking and permissions.

voice_cannot_speak.message: The bot is server-muted or suppressed on a Stage. Allow it to speak first.

tts_invalid_text.message: Enter a non-blank TTS message with at most 255 characters.

tts_unavailable.message: Configure a Home Assistant TTS provider first.

tts_generation_failed.message: Home Assistant could not generate the speech audio.

tts_ffmpeg_failed.message: FFmpeg could not start. Check the Home Assistant FFmpeg installation.

tts_playback_failed.message: Discord audio playback failed or timed out.

tts_queue_full.message: At most five announcements can be active or queued.

tts_interrupted.message: The announcement was canceled, for example by a channel change or shutdown.

dm_sending.message: A message to this member is already being sent.

voice_invalid_volume.message: Volume must be a whole number between 0 and 100.

tts_opus_unavailable.message: The Opus library is missing. Install libopus for audio playback.

send_direct_message.name: Send direct message
send_direct_message.description: Send text to an existing member device using its configured bot.

content.name: Message
content.description: 1 to 2000 characters; mention notifications are disabled.
